description: What the parity checks report for BrokenProbe, the same in every stack. TypeScript (React, Vue) and PHP (Blade) are both held to this list.
rendered: prop loading: true renders none of aria-busy=true, data-loading
prop leadingIcon: has no effect on the markup
part badge: rendered but not in the manifest
declared: prop loading: not declared by the {stack} component
prop leadingIcon: not declared by the {stack} component
prop tone: declared but not in the manifest
event press: not emitted by the {stack} component
event click: emitted but not in the manifest
